scope: Bevart teglverksbygning med ringovn, ikke det nedlagte Bryn Teglverk og ikke Den Norske Zinkhvidt-Fabrik.

evidence.conclusion: Property number 18 is identified as former Kristiania Teglverk; number 14 is identified as the former Den Norske Zinkhvidt-Fabrik.
Identifies the surviving timber-frame brickworks with north-east brick gable and intact ring kiln at no. 18; distinguishes neighbouring historic works.
Describes preserved Kristiania Teglverk at no. 14, in conflict with building-specific sources.
Local historians explicitly corrected confusion between Bryn Teglverk and Kristiania Teglverk, highlighting the surviving kiln.

Municipal heritage report names Kristiania teglverk and Zinkhvittfabrikken as paired cultural heritage properties at nos. 14 and 18, and attributes the historic timber/brick teglverk building to no. 18. This extracted fragment is not a certified parcel or entrance map.

Recent renovation project explicitly names Christiania teglverksbygget at 18, describes retained historic kiln and three storeys, and reports cadastre gnr/bnr 137/31. Project information does not show a verified public visitor entrance or prove present safe access.
Separately associates Kristiania teglverk with no. 18, and describes surviving building reused as pallet storage.

assessment.basis: Historical property index, specialist brickworks description, municipal heritage-document excerpt, recent building-project listing and citywide brickworks index independently point to no. 18. Oslo byleksikon still says 14; excerpt and derivative building records are not verified parcel geometry or visitor access.
assessment.warning: Do not copy the coordinates of the street article: those locate Nils Hansens vei generally, not the kiln building or a public entrance.
assessment.public_access_warning: Building-project page documents current/ongoing warehouse upgrade; preservation does not imply public interior access or permission to enter industrial property. Use only independently verified public footpath for any future pin.

release_blockers: Validate gnr/bnr 137/31 and specific surviving kiln-building footprint with primary municipal property/building documents
Resolve the Oslo byleksikon no.14 discrepancy explicitly against official building identity
Verify publicly accessible exterior observation point, safety and 2026 access; no private-site entry
Visually match Roy Olsen 2011 photo's depicted structure to the kiln-building facade and license original bytes
Perform per-claim source review, canonical rule_preflight and app mobile/desktop QA
